name: Iris
source:
"I'm Iris, the chairwoman of Iris Corporation. Just sitting around doing nothing is tiring... so I decided to work hard here. Please look forward to End to Odyssey, which I'm developing with Shiina and the others."

The chairwoman and founder of Iris Corporation, a company that develops and publishes games. She is a Luden. Together with the current CEO, [url=/c160581]Werner Glock[/url], she gathered the former staff of Enigma Corporation to form Iris Corporation. It seems she's created other things, too, but it's unclear how much she actually remembers about them...

Her ideal life is to simply make games filled with dreams and hope. End to Odyssey, the sequel to World's Odyssey, is shaping up to have quite the dark and intense story under [url=/c160573]Shiina's[/url] direction, which pains Iris. Poor thing...

For some reason, she treats the newly hired [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] rather coldly. There's a very serious reason for that, but it's too much for Sayaka, so we won't explain it here...

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category1&ch=iris]official website[/url]]
